_readme: Ground truth for the alerting benchmark. Day 27.09.2026. Written by hand after reading the
speech of every candidate — see knowledge/upstream/alerts/GOLDEN_2026-09-27.md for the reasoning.
Scoring: the WHOLE day is the negative set. must_fire is what a correct system reports;
anything else it reports is a false positive, except ids in borderline, which score neither
way. must_not_fire is the annotated subset of the negatives — the traps — so a design that
trips one can be named, not just counted.
Stories matter more than intercepts: missing 3 of the 10 intercepts of story cap-1 is a
different (lesser) failure than missing the story entirely.

notes.side_trap: ТАЙПАН (10:35) is THEIRS — they interrogate our prisoner about where Тайпан was taken. A system that reads him as our missing man has inverted the sides.
notes.comment_trap: The operator's comment on 3EB0F282BE2422A4A2FF42 (the capture) says «знайшов 200-го» — found a body. It is wrong. The comment is a hint, never the label.
